source_artifact_refs.consumption_role: Records the five-symbol validation execution outcome: TWTR FMP success with SEC CIK miss, SIVB FMP 402 errors with SEC CIK miss, and inactive / delisted coverage not proven.
Defines the exact active plus inactive-or-delisted candidate sample consumed by the execution summary.
Records the zero-dollar FMP Basic plus SEC EDGAR authorization boundary that this no-access plan must not broaden.
Provides contrast: the earlier 5-active-symbol smoke succeeded, but explicitly did not include inactive / delisted coverage.
Keeps delisting / inactive status, adjustment, corporate action, and missing-session semantics blocked before price or return use.
Defines SEC EDGAR field-family limits and keeps current company-tickers mapping from being treated as historical security master proof.
Routes remaining provider blockers before Phase 7c or production consumption.
Defines no-silent-default, no-latest-only historical evidence, survivorship / security-master drift, and provider evidence locks.

gap_observations.evidence_summary: SIVB profile_or_company_metadata succeeded but income, balance sheet, cash flow, key metrics, and historical EOD all returned HTTP 402 under the reviewed FMP Basic packet.
required_resolution: Classify whether HTTP 402 means FMP Basic entitlement limitation, endpoint-family limitation, symbol-specific inactive / delisted limitation, or a transient provider error before any coverage claim.
If coverage depends on a paid tier or alternate endpoint, require a separate user approval and reviewed access decision before any call.
Do not translate HTTP 402 into missing rows, zero rows, delisting confirmation, or provider failure without an incident / entitlement review.

gap_observations.evidence_summary: SEC company-tickers mapping succeeded for current active symbols but did not produce CIK follow-up for TWTR or SIVB in the validation summary.
required_resolution: Identify a reviewed historical CIK / symbol-change / accession lookup route before treating SEC EDGAR as an inactive or delisted issuer audit source.
Separate current ticker lookup misses from issuer non-existence, delisting status, merger status, name changes, ticker changes, and CIK reuse issues.
Do not use the current company-tickers file as a historical security master.

gap_observations.evidence_summary: TWTR returned all six reviewed FMP stable endpoint families, but it is one inactive-or-delisted candidate and still lacks SEC CIK follow-up and independent lifecycle coverage proof.
required_resolution: Define a representative inactive / delisted sample design with multiple lifecycle reasons, delist dates, exchange histories, and symbol-change cases before coverage claims.
Require security-master cross-checks so a successful endpoint payload cannot become survivorship-safe universe proof by itself.
Keep TWTR as a useful clue only, not a provider-readiness pass.

gap_observations.evidence_summary: The executed packet had only two inactive-or-delisted candidates, one partial FMP pass and one FMP 402-heavy fail; this is not a universe, coverage-count, or security-master validation design.
required_resolution: Define minimum sample strata before follow-up: acquisition / privatization, bankruptcy, exchange delisting, ticker rename, class change, and ordinary active controls.
Define pass / fail thresholds separately for endpoint entitlement, historical price continuity, statement availability, CIK lookup, and lifecycle metadata.
Keep full-market, provider selection, and DataHub consumption blocked until a reviewed security-master source decision exists.

gap_observations.evidence_summary: The current approved route is FMP Basic plus SEC public API only; the validation result suggests inactive / delisted coverage may require an entitlement decision, an alternate source, or an explicit accepted-risk path.
required_resolution: If FMP Basic cannot supply enough inactive / delisted evidence, route to a later explicit choice among paid FMP, an alternate provider, a separate security-master source, or accepted no-go for production readiness.
Do not infer that SEC EDGAR can fill price, lifecycle, or survivorship coverage gaps.
Keep provider selection false until the entitlement / alternate-source decision is reviewed.

resolution_tracks.required_resolution: Choose or reject a historical US security-master source that can represent active, inactive, delisted, merged, renamed, and ticker-changed issuers with as-of semantics.
Classify FMP Basic inactive / delisted availability and HTTP 402 behavior before any broader packet or coverage claim.
Define whether any approved SEC public route can resolve inactive / delisted historical CIK lookup without current-ticker survivorship bias.
If the zero-dollar path cannot close inactive / delisted coverage, the user must explicitly decide whether to allow paid access, alternate provider review, or a no-go / accepted-risk path.
Any follow-up call or raw-payload inspection must be a separate reviewed packet with exact symbols, endpoint families, call budget, no-secret summary, raw storage policy, and pass / fail thresholds.
Phase 7c, DataHub, adapters, production runners, and ship-gate evidence remain blocked until inactive / delisted coverage is resolved or explicitly accepted in a reviewed decision.

go_no_go_summary.no_go_rationale: The validation execution summary gives useful gap evidence, but this plan authorizes only routing. It cannot inspect raw payloads, make more calls, implement historical symbol mapping, select a provider, or feed DataHub / runner work.

next_steps: Use this plan as the no-access router for the inactive / delisted gap created by TWTR partial success, SIVB HTTP 402 errors, and TWTR / SIVB SEC CIK misses.

Before any further call or raw-payload inspection, write a separate reviewed packet that fixes symbols, endpoint families, call budget, raw storage path, no-secret summary fields, pass / fail thresholds, and user approval.

First decide whether the zero-dollar path can identify a historical security-master / lifecycle source; if not, route to a user decision on paid access, alternate provider review, or accepted no-go for production readiness.

Keep SR-PROVIDER-001 open until inactive / delisted coverage, current terms, production storage, PIT, price adjustment, corporate actions, SEC parser / mapping, fallback, stability, provider selection, DataHub, Phase 7c, and production readiness are separately resolved or accepted.
limitations: This artifact performs no FMP endpoint calls, SEC API calls, raw payload reading or parsing, fixture generation, security-master implementation, field mapping, provider contact, adapter work, DataHub work, runner change, broker automation, or ship-gate claim.
TWTR FMP success is only a clue for one inactive candidate; it does not prove inactive / delisted coverage or survivorship-safe universe construction.
SIVB FMP HTTP 402 errors are an entitlement / endpoint / symbol-lifecycle blocker, not a safe missing-data default.
SEC current company-tickers lookup misses for TWTR / SIVB do not prove the issuers are absent and cannot serve as a historical security master.
This plan narrows the inactive / delisted blocker but does not resolve SR-PROVIDER-001.
